summary: Case-insensitive string comparison with a maximum compare length a3. When a3 is zero the function returns 0 immediately. When the global locale flag is set it takes a locale-aware path that folds each character pair through sub_58B4D4 (locale character conversion) under a reference-counted critical section (entered via CriticalSectionLazyInitEnter(19) only when another thread is inside, otherwise a plain interlocked counter is kept); otherwise it uses an ASCII fast path that manually lowercases 'A'..'Z' by adding 32. Both paths stop at a null terminator in either string and return -1/0/1 according to the first differing character pair, comparing against the remaining length countdown.

operations.description: Guard on a3: when the maximum compare length is zero, skip all work and return a3 (0).
Branch on the global locale-thread-safe flag: non-zero selects the locale-aware path, zero selects the ASCII fast path.
Locale-aware path: increment the global reference counter dword_8D5A5C with an interlocked add, then test whether the thread-count global dword_8D5A58 is positive.

When dword_8D5A58 > 0 another thread is inside: release the interlocked counter, enter critical section 19 and remember that the section must later be left (v16 = 1). Otherwise keep the interlocked counter and do not touch the critical section (v16 = 0).
CriticalSectionLazyInitEnter(19) acquires the shared critical section used to serialize the locale-aware comparison.
Iterate the two input buffers in parallel, reading one byte from each (field 0 of the first input, i.e. *a1); stop when either byte is a null terminator.
Fold both characters through sub_58B4D4 (locale-aware character conversion) before comparing.

Compare the folded characters; on mismatch return -1 when the first is less than the second and 1 when greater. On match decrement the remaining-length counter and continue until the length runs out (v15 becomes 1) or a null terminator appears.
When the loop exhausts the compare length with all characters equal, return 0.
If the critical section was entered (v16), leave critical section 19 with CritSectLeave(19) and return the saved result.
If the critical section was not entered, release the interlocked reference counter dword_8D5A5C with a decrement instead.
ASCII fast path: read one byte from each input, stop at a null terminator, and advance both pointers.
Manually lowercase each byte in the range 0x41..0x5A ('A'..'Z') by adding 32, then compare the pair; on mismatch return -1 or 1, on match decrement the length counter and continue.
When the fast-path length counter runs out with all characters equal, return 0.
